name: Hex Truchet
description: Hexagonal truchet tiles: three arcs in every hexagon, each joining two neighboring sides, so the arcs link into long meandering loops with no ends.

code.style: --rule: ( --gate: @r(1); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-transform: translateX(@calc(50 - 50 * (@y % 2))%); transform: translateX(@calc(50 - 50 * (@y % 2))%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -25%; top: -25%; width: 150%; height: 150%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @var(--hm); mask: @var(--hm); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--hc); clip-path: @var(--hc); -webkit-transform: rotate(@p(0deg, 180deg)); transform: rotate(@p(0deg, 180deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -125%; top: -25%; width: 150%; height: 150%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); opacity: @calc(max(0, 2 - @x) * (1 - @y % 2)); -webkit-mask: @var(--hm); mask: @var(--hm); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--hc); clip-path: @var(--hc); -webkit-transform: rotate(@p(0deg, 180deg)); transform: rotate(@p(0deg, 180deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --hm: radial-gradient(ellipse 33.33% 33.33% at 50% 4.17%, transparent 50.5%, #000 50.5% 74.5%, transparent 74.5%), radial-gradient(ellipse 33.33% 33.33% at 83.33% 70.83%, transparent 50.5%, #000 50.5% 74.5%, transparent 74.5%), radial-gradient(ellipse 33.33% 33.33% at 16.67% 70.83%, transparent 50.5%, #000 50.5% 74.5%, transparent 74.5%); --hc: polygon(50% 4.17%, 83.33% 29.17%, 83.33% 70.83%, 50% 95.83%, 16.67% 70.83%, 16.67% 29.17%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
